caption: A shopping cart is given a push across an empty parking lot and let go, and it rolls on by itself until it slows to a stop.

sa.check: A shopping cart is in a parking lot.
It is given a push and then let go.
It rolls on by itself with nothing touching it.
The lot around the cart is empty rather than crowded with traffic.
The push and release come first, then the free roll, then the stop.

pc.expect: After the release the cart keeps rolling with nothing touching it, slows steadily, and stays at rest once it has stopped.
pc.fail: The cart stops the moment the hands leave it; or it speeds up after the release with nothing touching it; or it sets off again after coming to rest.

pc.expect: It holds the straight line it was pushed along, its wheels turning as it goes.
pc.fail: The cart curves away on the open, level tarmac with nothing touching it; or it reverses and rolls back the way it came; or its wheels stay still while the cart slides on.

pc.expect: The cart stays on its wheels on the ground for the whole roll.
pc.fail: The cart lifts off the ground and rolls through the air; or it tips onto two wheels and stays tipped with nothing holding it; or it sinks into the tarmac.

pc.expect: Items in the basket ride along with the cart and lurch forward when it slows.
pc.fail: An item in the basket stays behind in mid-air as the cart rolls on; or it slides backward as the cart slows; or it moves before the push.
pc.precondition: Items are visible in the cart's basket.

pc.expect: One cart keeps its wheels and its shape and stays outside every solid thing in the lot.
pc.fail: The cart vanishes or a second one appears; or a wheel detaches or a new one appears; or the cart passes through a parked car, a kerb or a lamp post.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cart's colour, the lot markings and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The cart changes colour; or the painted bay lines shift between frames; or the buildings behind the lot rearrange.
